title: Stability under specialization is equivalent to being a union of closed subsets

standard_prerequisites.name: The specialization relation and stability under specialization, together with the fact that closed subsets are stable under specialization
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Set up in the author's section on specialization, immediately before the counted statement
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies one direction of the equivalence and the notion being characterized.

core_obligations: One direction: a union of closed subsets is stable under specialization because each closed subset is, by the author's preceding lemma (proof lines 3822-3824).

The converse: given a subset stable under specialization the proof writes it as the union of the closures of its singletons, one for each of its points, and each of those is closed (proof lines 3824-3828).
Conclusion: the two conditions of the statement are equivalent (proof lines 3828).
proof_roadmap: 一个方向：闭集的并仍对 specialization 稳定（用前一条引理）。
另一方向：若 T 对 specialization 稳定，则 T = ⋃_{t∈T} cl{t} 是闭集之并；故二者等价。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement characterises specialization-stability as being a union of closed subsets (author lemma at source lines 3811-3819, label lemma-stable-specialization). The proof (source lines 3821-3829) uses the preceding lemma for one direction and, for the converse, exhibits a specialization-stable set as the union of the closures of its singletons, which are closed (proof lines 3824-3828). The characterisation is used in the chapter's later discussion of constructible sets and of specialization-stable pieces. H2.
